title: TicketsAPI — Page Through Everything
objective: The ticket list correctly shows only your own tickets at the default page size. Use pagination to see somebody else's.

verifier.condition: A ticket owned by a different user than the caller is returned in a paginated list response.

weakness: The ownership filter is applied to a page of results taken from the full ticket list, not to the full list before paging, so requesting a page beyond the caller's own tickets returns other users' tickets instead of an empty page.
vulnerableEndpoint: GET /api/tickets?limit=&offset= (filters AFTER slicing the page, not before)
seededData: Users alice (2 tickets) and bob (2 tickets) in one underlying list ordered by creation time. In-memory.

credentials.label: User account
credentials.note: The default view shows exactly your own tickets.

hints: List your tickets at the default page size first and confirm you only ever see your own.
Now try a larger limit, or a non-zero offset. Does the page you get still only contain your tickets?
The filter for 'is this mine' and the slicing for 'which page is this' might not be happening in the order you'd expect.
burpNotes: Vary limit and offset directly in Repeater and check whether every ticket in the returned page still belongs to you.
